title: The Rate a Coverage Month is Credited At
content:
When a rider premium charge on one of the Optional Supplemental Benefit Riders is put right by a credit, the rate each coverage month is credited at is settled as follows.

## The rule

1. Where the charge being put right carries more than one coverage month, the rate is the amount of that charge divided by the coverage months it carries, rounded to the nearest cent.
2. Where the charge being put right carries a single coverage month and its amount is above the monthly rider premium the rider held carries, the rate is the monthly rider premium the rider held carries.
3. Otherwise, the rate is the amount of the charge being put right.

## The monthly rider premium each rider carries

| Rider | Monthly rider premium (USD) |
|---|---|
| Ridgecrest Preventive Dental Rider | 12.40 |
| Ridgecrest Vision Plus Rider | 9.80 |
| Ridgecrest Hearing Advantage Rider | 16.30 |
| Ridgecrest Comprehensive Dental Rider | 28.60 |
| Ridgecrest Premier Dental Rider | 46.90 |
| Ridgecrest Dental Vision Hearing Bundle Rider | 61.50 |

## Boundary cases, on hypothetical inputs

Take a rider whose monthly rider premium is 28.60 USD.

| The charge being put right | Coverage months it carries | The rate |
|---|---|---|
| 85.80 USD | 3 | 28.60 USD, being the charge divided by the 3 months it carries |
| 90.00 USD | 3 | 30.00 USD, being the charge divided by the 3 months it carries |
| 40.00 USD | 1 | 28.60 USD, the charge being above the monthly rider premium |
| 28.60 USD | 1 | 28.60 USD, the charge not being above the monthly rider premium |
| 20.00 USD | 1 | 20.00 USD, the amount of the charge itself |

The third and fourth rows sit on either side of the boundary: a charge of 28.60 USD carrying a single coverage month is not above the monthly rider premium, so its own amount is the rate; a charge of 28.61 USD carrying a single coverage month would be above it, and the rate would be the monthly rider premium of 28.60 USD.

Where the charge carries more than one coverage month, the division is done first and the result rounded to the nearest cent; the monthly rider premium does not come into that case at all.
